cloudflare.retention_note: httpRequestsAdaptiveGroups on this Pro zone refuses data older than 1w1d (measured: query at -14d returns extensions.code=quota, "cannot request data older than 1w1d"). A 30-day per-path pull is IMPOSSIBLE on this plan. httpRequests1dGroups retains 30d but has no host dimension.

path_ua_day_slices.note: The whole-window path×UA×country grouping saturates the 10,000-row API cap on this host, so it is pulled one day at a time and summed in-script. Any slice that still hits the cap is halved and re-pulled; a sub-hour slice at the cap aborts the run (exit 2).

effective_window.note: Host data covers the requested window.

sampling.note: count is the sample-adjusted request estimate returned by the adaptive dataset.

github_traffic.window: 14 days, rolling, as served by GitHub

registry_referral_baseline.why: Baseline for the registry-placement experiment: if better registry rank is worth anything, these two numbers rise. Rank alone is not the outcome; visits are.

effective_window.note: Host data covers the requested window.

storefront_side.note: Cloudflare records a referer host, not a person. These are raw requests; the render-proven human filter is not applied per-referer because the referer dimension and the userAgent dimension are separate groupings.

user_initiated_assistant_fetches.note: The assistant-crawler side of the same question. ClaudeBot/GPTBot are scheduled crawls; Claude-User, ChatGPT-User and Perplexity-User are fetches a PERSON triggered by asking an assistant about a page. That is the only measurable proxy for an assistant surface sending a human here.

crawler_url_coverage_previous_set.source: data/traffic.json as it stood before this run

render_proven_ua_profile.why: A render-proven UA is proof a rendering engine ran, NOT proof of a person. Breadth separates the two: a reader touches a few pages, a rendering crawler touches many. Rows with distinct_sitemap_urls >= 10 are counted as sweepers and their page views are reported separately, so the human figure has a stated floor.
render_proven_ua_profile.multi_country_note: One UA string appearing from several countries in one week is a proxy-pool tell, not a traveller. Reported because it is the cheapest available evidence that a render-proven UA is not one person.

classification_rules.search_ai_crawler: Googlebot, Google-Extended, GoogleOther, Google-CloudVertexBot, Google-InspectionTool, bingbot, GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Amazonbot, Applebot, DuckDuckBot, YandexBot, Baiduspider, Bytespider, meta-externalagent, CCBot, cohere-ai, MistralAI-User, YouBot, Kagi, PetalBot, SeekportBot, Diffbot, Timpibot, omgili, ImagesiftBot
classification_rules.human_verified: human_browser UA that ALSO fetched /^\/(cdn-cgi\/|favicon\.ico|assets\/|apple-touch-icon)/ somewhere in the window (proves a real rendering engine ran).

activation.command: Cloudflare GET /accounts/<account>/storage/kv/namespaces/<namespace>/keys?limit=1000 with full cursor pagination; no KV values read
limitations: KV populations include probes and operator activity; none prove human activation.
Token records expire after 30 days and refresh on calls; not lifetime mints.
anon: docs are per tenant/server pairs; tok: counts tokens, not stored-data tenants.
License storage may contain webhook/instrumentation rows; raw total is not minted licenses.
Bindings may also be created by license_activate with signed test keys; not proof of payment.

account_control.scope_note: Shared-account counts only as a nonzero read control; unrelated storefront monetary totals and daily activity omitted.

stripe.limitation: Latest-100 sample is not lifetime. Separate status=complete pagination exhausts all available completed Checkout Sessions and finds zero MCP sessions. This measures checkout gross only, not every payment channel or net business revenue.

full_history_attempt.reason: Account history exceeded 5000 sessions; stopped at pagination guard. No lifetime revenue claim.

completed_history_audit.scope: Success URL hostname exactly mcp.zovo.one; metadata.probe=1 excluded from commercial totals

search_console.source: Google Search Console searchAnalytics/query with read-only service-account JWT; HTTP and API errors explicitly checked
limitations: Inclusive date range is 29 dates, not exactly 28 days.
Search queries can be anonymized; visible query rows do not sum to page totals.
Impressions are not indexed-page counts; no current full URL inspection census.

upgrade_clicks.counting_rule: a click counts only when the request carries sec-fetch-mode: navigate AND sec-fetch-dest: document, its User-Agent names no crawler or HTTP library, it sends no x-mcp-probe header, it carries a Referer (any origin, real browsers always send one; scripts and the 2026-09-17 setup-page walker do not), and its ?src= is one a live page emits. Everything else is either not counted or bucketed under unattributed.*, which is excluded from total_clicks and clicks_7d.
upgrade_clicks.note: Browser-header guard reduces probes but does not identify humans. Historical counter is a positive read control; no synthetic click sent.

audit.freshness: Channels retain individual measured_at/fetched_at and window fields; no shared funnel denominator.
limitations: Cloudflare adaptive request estimates, not people; rendering proof is shared by exact UA across the whole window, so browser automation and shared UA can pass.
The historical PL country exclusion is not a reliable operator exclusion; current task timezone is Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.
GitHub unique visitors are as served by GitHub and not independently verified human identities.
Claude-User groups also include Claude-SearchBot and anthropic-ai; PerplexityBot groups include scheduled and user fetches; do not label these all person-initiated.

Unfiltered Stripe history exceeds 5000 sessions; separate completed-only pagination exhausts 182 account sessions and finds zero MCP checkout gross. Other payment channels, refunds, fees and profit are outside this measurement.

recommendations.action: Measure first successful job and upgrade impressions by token cohort while excluding explicit probes; do not use KV document counts as people.
recommendations.evidence: 32 anonymous data tenants, 0 live token records, 49 locally signed license IDs, 0 paid checkout license records.

recommendations.action: Focus distribution work on mcpservers.org and individual GitHub mirrors; measure referred first jobs rather than additional listing totals.
recommendations.evidence: 239 of 242 raw registry-ecosystem storefront referrals are mcpservers.org; GitHub has 25 uniques in 14 days.

recommendations.action: Earn product-specific buyer-intent search exposure using demonstrated jobs and source citations; avoid calling crawl coverage demand.
recommendations.evidence: 34 GSC impressions/0 clicks across 29 dates, only three impression-bearing URLs, visible query site:zovo.one.
